_readme: What the same thing costs on its own, from the provider's own page. A perk in card_benefits.json or memberships.json points at one with worth_price (and worth_units: how many a year it includes; none = per use).
per: use | month | year | percent. The database works out each perk's worth and the sentence explaining it from these.
The monthly card check re-reads source_url and updates amount when the page quotes a new one; a reload never rolls back a newer last_verified.
Figures read on 2026-11-01..03 from each page's own text via web search (the pages could not be opened from the build environment).

prices.label: lounge visit
prices.basis: What Priority Pass charges its Standard members for each lounge visit.

prices.label: United Club pass
prices.basis: United's price for a one-time United Club pass.

prices.label: checked bag
prices.basis: Delta's fee for a first checked bag on U.S. flights (tickets bought from April 8, 2026), each way.

prices.label: checked bag
prices.basis: United's prepaid fee for a first checked bag on most U.S. flights (tickets bought from April 3, 2026), each way.

prices.label: year of DashPass
prices.basis: DoorDash's price for a year of DashPass on the annual plan.

prices.label: month of Netflix
prices.basis: Netflix's price for Standard with ads (from March 26, 2026).

prices.label: month of Peacock
prices.basis: Peacock's price for Premium with ads (from August 18, 2026).

prices.label: month of Paramount+
prices.basis: Paramount+'s price for Essential with ads (from January 15, 2026).

prices.label: month of Prime Video
prices.basis: Amazon's price for Prime Video on its own, with ads.

prices.label: year of Walmart+
prices.basis: Walmart's price for a year of Walmart+.

prices.label: anniversary bonus
prices.basis: Capital One says the 10,000 anniversary miles equal $100 toward travel.

prices.label: foreign transaction fee
prices.basis: The 3% foreign transaction fee many cards charge (Chase Freedom Unlimited's, for one), saved on what you spent abroad.
